movie.title: Space Jam
movie.overview: With their freedom on the line, the Looney Tunes seek the help of NBA superstar Michael Jordan to win a basketball game against a team of moronic aliens.

facts: Did you know Space Jam had a whole squad of writers? The script was penned by no less than four people: Leo Benvenuti, Steve Rudnick, Timothy Harris, and Herschel Weingrod. Talk about a collaborative effort!

Beyond Michael Jordan, the live-action cast featured some other familiar faces you might not immediately recall. For instance, Wayne Knight, famous for playing Newman in 'Seinfeld,' was also part of the human ensemble!

The invading aliens in Space Jam weren't just after world domination, they had a very specific, quirky plan for the Looney Tunes. Their goal was to enslave them and turn them into amusement park attractions!
